exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.target: Glutes and back of the legs
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
exercises.tip: Squeeze your glutes as you lift.
exercises.mistake: Don't arch your back too much.

exercises.name: Back Press
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, knees bent.
steps: Notice the gap under your lower back.
Pull your belly in and press your back down.
exercises.tip: Hips stay down; only your back touches the floor.

exercises.name: Pillow Squeeze
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, a pillow between your knees.
steps: Squeeze the pillow with your knees.

exercises.name: Clamshell
exercises.setup: Lie on your side, knees bent, feet together.

exercises.name: Knee-to-Chest Stretch
exercises.setup: Lie on your back, knees bent.
steps: Pull your knees to your chest.
Breathe out, bring them a little closer.
exercises.tip: Keep your head on the floor.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.setup: On your back; arms up, knees bent in the air.
steps: Reach one arm and the opposite leg.
Keep your back on the floor.
exercises.mistake: If your back lifts, reach less.

exercises.name: Squat
steps: Sit down as if onto a chair.
Push through your heels to stand.
exercises.mistake: Don't let your knees cave in.

exercises.name: Sumo Squat
steps: Open your knees and squat down.
Knees point the same way as your toes.
Squeeze your hips as you stand.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.setup: Elbows and toes on the floor.
exercises.tip: If it's hard, put your knees down.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
steps: Reach one arm and the opposite leg.

exercises.name: Hip Opener Stretch
exercises.setup: One knee down, the other foot in front.
steps: Feel the stretch at the front of the back leg.

exercises.name: Butterfly Stretch
exercises.setup: Sit with the soles of your feet together.
steps: Breathe out, let your knees drop.
Relax a little more with each breath.
